rv.q: Rejinal Simon was sensational as Kingsley, the articulate man-child whose father left him at twelve to oppose racial injustice against the negro and fight for his equality.
In a superb performance, Reji Simon plays the character of Adam Kingsley with elegance, aplomb, and skill.

cn.t: David Alex's socio-political drama earns praise for its powerful, unflinching examination of race and racism through the unlikely bond between two men from different backgrounds, delivering an engaging character study that pulls no punches.
